summary: Bus zone kerb on a busy Moggill Road junction, dwelling 14 m away.
reasons: Busy main road, no parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 14 m and 20 m on the same side; shops and an office beside.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of a through road at a junction; no pull-off, no cars parked.
drivers.traffic: Busy multi-lane road with a painted island at the junction.
drivers.convention: Bus Zone 4-7pm Mon-Sat; no parked cars seen along this kerb.

sun_shade: Large tree canopy over the kerb; shade most of the day.

best_section.where: South kerb of Moggill Road at the side-street junction, under a large tree
